approval.note: Verified source, independent integer calculation, recent successful Deposit/Withdraw receipt, administrative controls, fixture tests and actual browser LIVE read passed. No exclusive-price or aggregator-marginalization claim.

valuation.methodology: Same-block native contract accounting; independent source-specific integer recalculation. No market-price API or cross-stablecoin peg assumption.

value.note: Contract accounting value per whole receipt/share; not exchange price or a guarantee of immediate withdrawal.

referenceSnapshot.note: Contract accounting value per whole receipt/share; not exchange price or a guarantee of immediate withdrawal.

recentActivity.note: Supplementary activity; approval uses operational getters, not arbitrary recent event frequency.

C01.evidence: Positive supply/assets; successful recent nonzero Deposit/Withdraw confirmed by direct RPC receipt. V1 capacity positive; V2 open gates and source-defined unsupported maxDeposit convention verified.

C05.evidence: Official deployment metadata + verified-source ABI + pinned runtime identity; Sourcify runtime compared where available.

C11.evidence: Actual browser LIVE at block 26193420; exact calculation, RPC outage, code/administrative changes and price mismatch fixture tests passed.

C12.evidence: Administrative permissions reviewed in source; code, proxy slots, authority/config getters and change-event watches recorded. Upgradeable contracts allowed, changes require revalidation.

C13.evidence: Independent integer calculation from separate same-block accounting calls equals native method exactly.

C14.evidence: Public admission gates completed; snapshot approval only.

referenceSnapshot.note: Scope: registered receipt/share token only; includes receivables and is not total protocol market capitalization or immediately available cash.
